decisions.reason: This looks more like a successful continuation and repositioning of an already accepted machine than a risky fresh launch, so performance likely meets aspiration and there is little reason to search for an exit.

A standalone page and a multi-model line indicate meaningful commitment, and for an established German machinery firm with service capabilities the product is likely given more time unless results clearly disappoint.

Website mention only gives a weaker market signal, but the grinder line fits the firm's core mobile processing business and boundedly rational management would usually retain it for another year while learning accumulates.

The stationary electric fine shredder is a narrower and possibly slower-selling niche offer, so shortfall risk is higher, but the firm's experience and strategic push toward resource-saving solutions make immediate withdrawal less likely than continued trial.

Although only lightly presented, the green-waste grinder extends the firm's established waste and biomass applications, so management is likely to keep it on the market while assessing whether it reaches acceptable demand.
A dedicated page and a full stationary pre-shredder line suggest strong strategic fit and internal commitment, making discontinuation within a year unlikely absent clear underperformance.
